sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-28b"
sources.quote: WASP-28b or K2-1b is an extrasolar planet discovered in 2010 by the Wide Angle Search for Planets (WASP) project orbiting WASP-28, a magnitude 12 star also known as 1SWASP J233427.87-013448.1, 2MASS J23342787-0134482 and K2-1.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around WASP-28. Its orbit and size follow Močnik et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-28b"
sources.quote: Since it orbits its star very closely, the planet is a strongly irradiated hot Jupiter.
